translation.text: Then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked out from heaven and saw much blood being poured out on the earth, and all the lawlessness being committed on the earth.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected Charles text crosses printed18 to20. Its starred second name is Uriel; Charles printed20note1 describes a name-list assembled from differing readings. The rendering follows that edited list, not a claim that every manuscript agrees. Printed18 superscript32 is an apparatus number, not a star before “then.”

translation.text: They said among themselves, “The voice of their cry—⟦meaning unresolved⟧—the earth cried out as far as the gate of heaven.”[a]

translation.text: [And now, to you, holy ones of heaven,] the souls of human beings bring their complaint, saying, “Present our case before the Most High.”[a]

translation.text: They said to their Lord, “⟦corrupt title fragment unresolved⟧, Lord of lords, God of gods, and King of kings, the throne of your glory throughout all generations of the world; your name is holy and glorious throughout the whole world, and blessed, [and ⟦word unresolved⟧].”[a]

translation.text: You have seen what Azazel did: he taught all lawlessness on the earth and revealed the secrets of the world—⟦the heavenly-practice clause remains unresolved⟧.[a]

footnotes.text: Charles printed22note15 explicitly describes corrupt verb forms and order in the clause beginning with the selected dagger. The selected words literally involve “those which are practiced,” “in the heavens,” and “humankind knew,” but I do not certify their relation as a complete English proposition. Only an opening dagger is printed in this Ethiopic body; no second dagger is silently inserted. This entire unit remains held.

translation.text: Now, look, the souls of those who died cry out and appeal as far as the gate of heaven. Their lament has ascended, and cannot ⟦the following construction remains unresolved⟧ before the lawlessness being committed on the earth.[a]

footnotes.text: The negative is preserved. Actual Dillmann col944 gives exit/depart/escape senses for ወጽአ, and cols462–463 discuss the before/from-before construction. This pass does not establish that “cannot cease because of” is warranted. The entire proposed unit remains held; the problem is not resolved by smoothing away the literal wording.

translation.text: You know everything before it happens, and you know this, †and what belongs to them†. Yet you have not told us what ⟦the final desire/action construction remains unresolved⟧ concerning this.[a]
